spec.forecast_origin: 11:00 Europe/Paris on D; forecast every actual hourly interval of D+1, including DST
spec.rte_policy: Use supplied rte_forecast_d1_mw as assumed available at the origin. No D2 product or 05:00 rule. Historical issue vintages remain unverified.
spec.arm_meaning: All targets are national consumption. Regional-only means regional historical predictors plus national RTE and known calendar; it does not mean a sum of regional targets or regional RTE.
spec.base_forecast_burnin: 2024 Q1; historical base configurations selected only from released earlier-quarter outcomes. Final base parameters selected over 2024, as in the original study.
spec.training_weight: 1 + (weight-1) * out-of-sample predicted probability of cold * known evening indicator. This is a function of available predictors; future realized cold labels are not prediction inputs.
spec.selection: Freeze minimum development weighted-MAE eligible candidate passing both MAE guardrails; if none passes, report no qualified winner. Also retain all candidate scores and the best unqualified diagnostic candidate.
spec.fit_policy: First origin of each delivery quarter; earlier outcomes may enter scheduled later fits once released. Same schedule for all new candidates. Original references retain their declared monthly policies.
spec.search: Two deterministic regularization/complexity configurations per variant. This is a bounded comparison, not exhaustive hyperparameter optimization.
spec.feature_ablation: LightGBM residual: basic, engineered, engineered plus causal learned features, crossed with training weight1/5 and all three arms. Extra direct-demand LightGBM arm for each dataset view.
spec.hybrid_scope: All23 original model variants (13 families) receive an individually trained LightGBM RTE-residual meta-model using their causal out-of-sample base forecast and engineered/learned predictors. These are explicitly hybrids, not native exogenous neural/statistical architectures. National base variants use national predictors; prior regional variants use combined predictors. No false regional-only base architecture claim.
spec.probability_selection: For the three standalone quantile-LightGBM residual arms, use the point-selected parameters, evaluate the quantile grid on development, and select lowest WIS across central50/90 intervals before calibration/test.
spec.uncertainty: Native quantile grid, central90 and asymmetric90 [q.075,q.975], past out-of-sample residual distribution, fixed-model split conformal and conformalized quantile regression. No finite-sample time-series coverage claim.

risk_scenarios.units: Weighted MW loss proxies, not euros

limitations: No archived forecast weather; only past observed weather and learned cold probabilities
National consumption is a portfolio proxy
Original compact neural budgets and anchor limitations persist in reused base forecasts
This expanded evaluation starts in Q2 because Q1 is required for causal hybrid burn-in
Cold labels used for retrospective segment scoring are distinct from pre-cutoff cold probabilities
spec.development_period: Q2-Q4 2024 plus Jan2-March31 2025. Jan1 excluded at base-archive boundary. These blocks include 102 cold-evening hours/41 days before selection.
spec.calibration_season_limit: April2-June29 2025 has zero realized cold-evening observations; held-out calibration cannot establish winter-conditional coverage.
